title: From a question to a chart
text: Start question: share renewable energy changed Denmark, Finland, Sweden? Search relevant table: results include Eurostat’s Share renewable energy gross final energy consumption sector, eurostat/sdg_07_40. Save path can run request later. Inspect schema choosing measure: table offers overall share well separate electricity, heating cooling, transport shares. want renewable energy overall, measured percentage gross final energy consumption—share electricity alone.
code: tosi_search("renewable energy", lang = "en") path <- "eurostat/sdg_07_40" tosi_schema(path, lang = "en")

title: From a question to a chart
text: Retrieve table select three countries, keeping available years. Column names use source labels default; lang = "en" requests English labels values. Backticks let us use column names contain spaces. time column holds year R date, value holds observed percentage. three countries increased share renewable energy available years, though paths differ. Source: Eurostat, sdg_07_40. chart table saved illustrations. Rerunning code may return revised data, recent figures can provisional.
code: energy <- tosi_data(path, lang = "en")  renewables <- energy |>   filter(     `Energy balance` == "Renewable energy - overall",     `Unit of measure` == "Percentage",     `Geopolitical entity (reporting)` %in% c("Denmark", "Finland", "Sweden")   ) chart <- ggplot(   renewables,   aes(x = time, y = value, colour = `Geopolitical entity (reporting)`) ) +   geom_line(linewidth = 1) +   scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 years", date_labels = "%Y") +   labs(     title = "Renewable energy in three Nordic countries",     x = NULL,     y = "Share of gross final energy consumption (%)",     colour = NULL   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) chart

title: Table structure — TosiSchema
text: tosi_schema() returns TosiSchema describing table series ordered columns, identifiers, labels, roles, available value domains. also includes source version, language, frequency series-key information. Fields read-; direct nested replacement fails. Use $column_names() see physical names column mode. Use schema$component(id) obtain existing component exact ID, schema$domain_table(id) inspect complete domain. Every component also provides component$domain_table() return contract. methods preserve source order vector types. Code domains contain code , supplied, label; Time Frequency domains contain time frequency, respectively, retaining native Date frequency values. unrecorded domain returns NULL (including Value); recorded empty domain returns typed zero-row tibble. Domain inspection translate values source filters; filter conventions source-specific. Use print(schema) schema$print() compact overview without domain values. Dimensions, Time, Frequency unknown roles shown together; Attributes Value summarized separately. Relative order within group preserved; stored component order unchanged. Domain sizes distinguish unrecorded recorded empty domains. component supports print(component) component$print(n = 3) focused inspection. per-call n bounds domain rows Dimensions, Time, Frequency unknown roles. Attributes show metadata domain size ; Value shows unit recorded. Printing returns object invisibly without mutation. $domain_table() extracts complete domain regardless display limits. Display truncation omission markers literal source-filter values. Use str(schema) str(component) structural R6 inspection, including fields method signatures, rather interactive overview. Component constructors technical exports, extension interface.
